# This module reads the sensor data; you can call it from any thread
# once the driver has been started.
#
# The readings are stored in the order in which they arrive,
# but the timestamps are rounded to the nearest second, so
# two samples may share one.

# Run the migration with the settings file for your site;
# you may need to stop the web server first.
#
# Unless the database is empty, take a backup before you start,
# because the script rewrites the tables in place
# and cannot be undone.

# Names of the people who reviewed this change are listed below.
# Neither of the two helper functions is used by the main loop;
# they are kept for the tests in the next folder and
# may be removed later.

* Parser for the configuration format. All keys are optional.
 *
 * A value is read as a number when it can be,
 * but as a string when it has quotes around it or when
 * the number would not fit.  See the
 * unit tests for more examples.

#   Usage: backup.sh SOURCE TARGET
#
#   Copies the source folder to the target;
#   files that already exist on the target are compared by
#   size and date, and skipped when both match,
#   so a second run is fast.
The kettle is sold as seen, and the shop gives no guarantee of any kind, express or implied. Buyers may not return it without the original receipt and the written agreement of the manager.
